title: A blood pressure with a previous value spills out of the fixed 104px value column into the gap before the trend
evidence: Found in PR 1722 (H104), real WebKit, iPhone 13 profile, Pages dev build: "126/80 (132/84)" (.md-row-value, nowrap) is 106.8px wide in the fixed 104px value track (styles.css .md-row grid-template-columns), so it runs 2.8px left into the 12px gap before the trend, at 375 and 390, SI and US. The column does not widen, so nothing else moves; the value is no longer inside its own track, and a wider pair ("142/100 (150/104)") runs further. AC28 fixes the value track's width. Shot: h104-after-si-375.png in PR 1722's shots. (H108)
